place.en: The hidden realm · The cliff wall

setup.zh: 头顶传来脚步声。马小宝和那五个人，带着一盘麻绳，顺着崖壁爬下来：「秘境里死个把人，可不稀奇。」你背后是墙，左手是不见底的崖口。
setup.en: Footsteps overhead. Ma Xiaobao and his five come climbing down the cliff with a coil of hemp rope. "People die in the hidden realm now and then." The wall is at your back; on your left, a drop with no bottom.

recap.zh: 马小宝六个人带着绳子追下崖来，要把你推下左崖。你踩下阵眼，六个人粘在了崖壁上。你知道怎么开，只说了一句「三天」。
recap.en: Ma Xiaobao and his five came down the cliff with a rope to push you off the left cliff. You stepped on the binding's eye and the six stuck fast to the rock. You knew how to open it, and said only: "Three days."

zh: 崖壁上，亮起一圈淡淡的光。
六个人，贴在崖壁上。一盘麻绳，悬在半空。
en: A faint ring of light glows on the cliff.
Six people stuck to the rock. A coil of rope hangs in the air.

story.zh:
小满抬头一看，崖顶上站着一排人，不多不少，正好六个。当中那个胖墩墩的，身上的新法衣在黑地里也看得出是簇新的，正是马小宝；他身后五个，便是柴房那天夜里的五个，卖地图的那两个在里头，老蔫也在里头，肩上那一大盘麻绳，已经卸下来，抄在那个抄着手的跟班手里。马小宝一只手叉着腰，居高临下：「沈小满，你以为躲到左边来，我就找不到你了吗？」他冲身后那个跟班一扬下巴，「你一进门，就有人给我报信了。原来你是个识货的——那面墙，开了？」小满站在墙前，没有说话。马小宝往他脚边那道黑沉沉的崖口望了一眼，又望回来，声音倒不响了：「秘境里头，死个把人，可不稀奇。门口躺着的那个锦袍的，谁多看了一眼？十年前下去三个，上来一个。今年嘛，里头还掺着外人——少上来一个，谁也不会多说一句。」说罢，领着五个人，顺着崖壁往下爬。

碎石子哗啦啦地响。小满背贴着墙，心里飞快地算了一遍：五个老弟子，练气三层的两个，二层的三个；马小宝练气三层，丹药一瓶一瓶硬喂上来的，底子虚得像一块泡了水的糕。自己才二层，左边的肋骨还没长牢。石台只有三四步宽，背后是墙，左手是崖口。六个人下到台上，用不着打得过他，只要一拥，一推，他便跟那半截烂麻绳拴过的人一样，往黑里去了。那盘绳子，是怕他扒住崖沿的时候用的。

他这时候才真正明白过来：这一回，是要他的命。

银月没有打哈欠。她在他肩上，身子绷得像一张拉满的弓，声音又低又快：「左脚边那块石头。踩下去。」小满低头一看，左脚边一块圆石，半埋在土里，石面上有九个浅浅的小坑，横三竖三，八个坑里嵌着石子，正中那一个是空的。他来不及问，一脚踩了上去。那石头往下一沉。

崖壁上登时亮起一圈淡淡的光，青白青白的，从崖脚一直亮到崖顶，像是有人拿一支极大的笔，在那面崖上画了一个圈。圈一亮，正往下爬的六个人，同时停住了——不是自己要停，是动不了了。一个个手脚张开，贴在崖壁上，脸朝着石头，任他们怎么挣，怎么蹬，就是挪不动半分。离石台最近的那个，脚尖只差一尺便落了地。那盘麻绳从抄着手的跟班手里滑脱了，一圈一圈散开，悬在半空里，也不动了。马小宝贴在最当中，只能拿眼角往下斜着看，叫道：「你——你干了什么！」

小满没有答。他的腿在抖，抖得膝盖碰着了墙。银月在他耳朵里道：「前人留下的困阵，护这面墙的，粘的是崖壁上的人。不去动它，它要粘到秘境关门——三天以后，石门合上前一个时辰，才自己松开。」她顿了一顿，「阵眼就在你脚底下。九个坑，缺个中——你往正中按一下，它现在就开。」

马小宝挣了半天，挣得满头大汗，脸上那点凶相一点一点地化了，声音软了下来：「沈……沈师弟。咱们一个村出来的。你把我们放下来，我给你十两银子。」小满没有说话。马小宝道：「二十两！」小满还是没有说话。马小宝憋了半天，道：「那……那公中，往后你不用交了！」

小满抬起头来，一个一个看过去。看那个抄着手的，看那个踹他右边肋骨的，看那盘悬在半空里的麻绳，看马小宝。末了，他看着离崖口最近的那一个。老蔫贴在崖壁的最外沿，半边身子悬在那道黑口子的上头，一声也没出，只拿眼角往下望着他。

他知道怎么开。正中那个空坑，他只要弯一弯腰。可开，是六个人一齐开；这道阵不认得谁说过「够了」，谁带了绳子。
story.en:
Xiaoman looked up: on the cliff top stood a row of people, six exactly. The plump one in the middle, his new robe brand-new even in the dark, was Ma Xiaobao; the five behind him were the five from the woodshed night — the two map sellers among them, Old Wilt among them, and the big coil of rope was off his shoulder now and in the hands of the follower with folded arms. One hand on his hip, Ma Xiaobao looked down: "Shen Xiaoman, did you think if you hid on the left I couldn't find you?" He jerked his chin at that follower. "The moment you went in, someone came and told me. So you know a good thing when you see it — that wall, it's open?" Xiaoman stood before the wall and said nothing. Ma Xiaobao glanced at the black drop by Xiaoman's feet and back again, and his voice was no longer loud: "In the hidden realm people die now and then. Nothing strange in it. That one in brocade lying back by the entrance — who gave him a second look? Ten years ago three went down and one came up. This year — there are outsiders in here too. One fewer comes up, and nobody says a word." And he led the five down the cliff.

Pebbles clattered. Back to the wall, Xiaoman reckoned fast: five seniors, two at layer three, three at layer two; Ma Xiaobao at layer three, force-fed bottle after bottle, his base soft as a cake soaked in water. He himself was only at two, his left rib not yet knit. The ledge was three or four paces wide, the wall behind him, the drop on his left. Six of them on the ledge needn't beat him; one rush, one shove, and he would go into the dark like whoever that half-rope had once held. The coil of rope was for when he caught the edge.

Only now did he truly understand: this time, they meant to kill him.

Yinyue didn't yawn. On his shoulder her body was taut as a drawn bow, her voice low and quick: "The stone by your left foot. Step on it." Xiaoman looked down: a round stone half sunk in the earth by his left foot, nine shallow hollows in its face, three by three, stones set in eight, the middle one empty. He had no time to ask; he stepped on it. The stone sank.

A faint ring of light lit up the cliff, blue-white, from foot to top, as if someone had drawn a circle on it with an enormous brush. The moment it lit, the six climbing down stopped all at once — not by choice; they couldn't move. Limbs spread, stuck to the rock, faces to the stone, and however they strained and kicked, they couldn't shift an inch. The one nearest the ledge was a foot from touching down. The coil of rope slipped from the folded-arms follower's hands, opened loop by loop, and hung in the air, still. Ma Xiaobao, stuck in the middle, could only squint down sideways: "You — what did you do!"

Xiaoman didn't answer. His legs were shaking so that his knees knocked the wall. Yinyue said in his ear: "A binding the old ones left to guard this wall; it holds whoever is on the cliff. Leave it be, and it holds until the realm closes — three days from now, an hour before the stone door shuts, it lets go by itself." She paused. "Its eye is under your foot. Nine hollows, the middle one missing — press the middle and it opens now."

Ma Xiaobao struggled a long while till the sweat poured off him, and the menace in his face melted bit by bit; his voice went soft: "Sh… Shen, little brother. We're from the same village. Let us down and I'll give you ten taels." Xiaoman said nothing. "Twenty!" Xiaoman still said nothing. After a long struggle: "Then… then the common fund — you won't have to pay it any more!"

Xiaoman raised his head and looked at them one by one. At the one with folded arms, at the one who had kicked his right ribs, at the coil of rope hanging in the air, at Ma Xiaobao. Last, he looked at the one nearest the drop. Old Wilt hung at the very outer edge of the cliff, half his body over that black mouth; he made not a sound, only looked down at him from the corner of his eye.

He knew how to open it. The empty hollow in the middle — he had only to bend down. But open meant all six at once; this binding didn't know who had said "Enough" and who had brought the rope.

exits.means: leaves them stuck for three days and goes through the wall

story.zh:
小满把脚从那块石头上挪开，站直了，道：「三天。」

说完，他转过身去，走进了那道墙。

身后，马小宝先是骂，骂他祖宗，骂他娘，骂到后来，骂成了求，求到后来，什么也听不清了。老蔫一句话也没有说。小满走在那道墙缝里，一步，两步，脚底下发飘，像踩在棉花上。他这辈子打过兔子、打过獐子，头一回，把六个人撂在了一道崖上；其中一个，一个时辰以前，刚在他耳朵边上说过一句「绳子，是带给你的」。
story.en:
Xiaoman took his foot off the stone, stood up straight, and said: "Three days."

And with that he turned and walked into the wall.

Behind him Ma Xiaobao cursed first — cursed his ancestors, cursed his mother — and the cursing turned to begging, and the begging turned to something no one could make out. Old Wilt said not a word. Xiaoman walked through the gap in the wall, one step, two, his feet unsteady, as if on cotton. He had shot hares and shot river deer; for the first time in his life he had left six people hanging on a cliff — and one of them, not two hours before, had said in his ear: "The rope — it's for you."

exits._grant: 古五 (2026-10-02): in the stone chamber 银月 draws 踏马的符 on his soles (wm-xirang's passage) — handed over here, so it is in the bag at the door of the chase (wm-xirang's duel). One use: its card summons the 蛫 as a 护主 against 邹青松's 四蛇合围.
